scope: Official public documentation, official App Server v0.161.0 DTO, and state reported by Root; no login, SSH, operational CLI/App Server calls, remote configuration, or infrastructure changes.
meta: Determine documented remote routes and PC-off constraints.
proof_of_fact: Linked sources and explicit separation of documented, reported, and unobserved state.
conclusion: Codex Cloud native is the documented Codex UI route for PC-off work; mapping to VPS or App Server IDs is not demonstrated.
With Hermes components reported as existing, VPS CLI plus Telegram is the implementable PC-off coordination route, conditional on proving service availability and effective CLI session/auth.
Desktop SSH is documented for visual control from an available macOS/Windows desktop host; this connection was not configured.
Sergio must decide which VPS route to operate and whether to configure an approved desktop SSH host or prioritize CLI plus Telegram.

Change CLI route status only after an isolated real CLI session, harmless task in a non-production copy, reconnection evidence, and observable Telegram result; record auth/cost without exposing secrets.
Change SSH route status only after an approved host is configured and an isolated visual read/edit test succeeds on a non-production copy.
Claim ID mapping or parity only with a documented contract or controlled correlation test; the thr_ example is insufficient.
